name: Imouto Choukyou Nikki ~Konna Tsundere ga Ore no Imouto na Wakenai!~
original_name: 妹調教日記～こんなツンデレが俺の妹なわけない!～
source:
The protagonist, a die-hard eroge fan, is into "exposure," "rape," and "training."  
One day, his real sister, Himeki Ichinose, snapped at him.  
"Shut up and train me if you're such a nerd!"  
Though it made no sense at all, this bizarre training life between brother and sister suddenly began.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ081727.html]dlsite[/url]]
